verdict.rationale: Abacum is a SaaS FP&A platform, so outbound webhooks are a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The edit-event history (docs-13) is an internal audit log and the integrations are inbound data connectors, both adjacent rather than event subscriptions, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
